faq.q: Can I buy a house right on the beach in Kassandra?
faq.a: You can buy an existing house on the first line, with only the public beach between you and the sea. You cannot own the beach itself, and new building close to the shoreline is restricted. Your lawyer checks the permits of the house before you buy.

faq.q: How much is seafront property in Kassandra, Halkidiki?
faq.a: Seafront homes are among the most expensive in Halkidiki, and prices depend on the beach, the size and the condition of the home. Apartments cost less than villas. Use the price filter to see current seafront homes in Kassandra. Ask us about running costs as well.

faq.q: Which side of Kassandra is best for seafront homes?
faq.a: It depends on what you value. The west coast has sunsets and long sandy beaches. The east coast has morning sun, calm water and more resorts nearby. We can show you seafront homes on both coasts in one day. Both coasts have sandy beaches.

body:
Seafront houses in Kassandra

Houses for sale in Kassandra on the first line are rare and in demand. Most are holiday homes with a garden opening onto the beach. Check winter access, the condition of the building after years of sea air, and how busy the beach gets in August.

Beachfront villas and apartments

Seafront villas offer privacy and pools, while seafront apartments are a more affordable way to wake up next to the water. Both come up in the resort villages along the two coasts.

East or west coast of Kassandra?

The west coast faces the Thermaic Gulf, with sunsets over the sea and long sandy beaches. The east coast faces Sithonia across the Toroneos Gulf, with morning sun and lively resorts. Visit both before deciding.

Building rules near the shore

As of November 2026, to be confirmed by our lawyer, the shore zone in Greece is public: nobody can own or fence the beach, and building close to the official shoreline is restricted. Existing seafront homes were built under the rules of their time, so your lawyer and an engineer check the permits of any home before you buy.
